comparison.objective: Vent a pressure pan before removing and placing its lid; unlike damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Button holding and level lid transfer after a physical wait condition; no recessed tool engagement, collar adjustment, or lock test.
comparison.success_condition: Vent must precede lid removal; lid ends flat on trivet with grippers released and withdrawn. Numeric thresholds and spec versions are absent.
comparison.reason: Although this duplicates pr-1816, it is clearly distinct from the candidate's mechanical commissioning ability.
